ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the left side of the figure is a schematic diagram of a river system in a certain basin, with a lake near the river and hydrological stations A and B marked; the right side of the figure shows the change curves of river discharge at hydrological stations A and B before and after the rainstorm, with time on the horizontal axis and discharge on the vertical axis. One curve has a high peak, arrives quickly, and recedes quickly, while the other curve has a lower peak, appears later, and has a gentler hydrograph. Then reason: a lake can store water when floodwaters arrive, reduce the flood peak, and slowly release water after the flood, delaying the arrival of the flood peak and prolonging the recession process. Therefore, the lake plays the role of regulating runoff volume for river runoff.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：右图中甲、乙水文站的流量过程线在暴雨后表现不同，一条曲线峰值高且来得快，另一条峰值较低、出现较晚且过程更平缓。再推理：湖泊经过蓄水和缓慢泄水，会削减洪峰、延缓洪峰到达、延长退水过程。因此根据曲线变化可判断湖泊对河流径流起到调节径流量的作用。
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图左为某流域水系示意图，河流附近有湖泊，并标出甲、乙水文站；图右为暴雨前后甲、乙两水文站的河流流量变化曲线，横轴是时间，纵轴是流量。其中一条曲线峰值高、来得快、退得也快，另一条曲线峰值较低、出现较晚，过程线更平缓。再推理：湖泊能在洪水来临时蓄水、削减洪峰，在洪水过后缓慢泄水，延缓洪峰到达并延长退水过程。因此，湖泊对河流径流起到调节径流量的作用。

planner_metadata.image_role: Read the right-hand flow-time graph: one curve rises sharply to a high peak soon after the rain, while the other curve has a lower, later, flatter peak and a longer recession. Read the left-hand map only enough to know the curves belong to the two hydrological stations in the same basin with a lake involved.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the question wording to focus specifically on “暴雨前后甲、乙两水文站的河流流量变化曲线” and ask for the lake’s role, not for station naming or numeric calculation.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Hydrological rule: if a lake stores part of floodwater during peak flow and releases it gradually afterward, the downstream hydrograph is flattened, delayed, and prolonged; this is called regulation of river runoff.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：左图显示该流域河道与湖泊相连，甲、乙水文站位于同一水系中；右图显示暴雨后两站流量曲线不同，其中受湖泊影响的一侧流量变化幅度较小、洪峰不尖锐。再推理：既然湖泊位于水系中并使暴雨径流过程由急涨急落变为较平缓的变化，说明它能在水多时蓄积、在水少时补给河流。由此概括湖泊的作用为调节径流量。
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：左图是某流域水系示意，河道与中部湖泊相连，甲、乙水文站位于同一水系的不同位置；右图是暴雨前后两站流量随时间变化曲线，X曲线洪峰较高且尖锐，Y曲线变化较平缓、峰值较低，洪峰不明显。再推理：湖泊与河流相连后，暴雨时可暂时蓄积部分来水，使下游流量不至于急剧增大；暴雨后又可逐渐向河流补给水量，使流量变化趋于平缓。因此湖泊对河流径流起到调节作用。

planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Bridge rule: a lake connected to a river acts as a temporary reservoir in the drainage network—intercepting/storing part of incoming runoff when flow increases and supplementing/releasing water when flow decreases—so it moderates changes in river discharge.
